summary: Assay worksheet for MV-2018-336, the QP07 absorption triage for Quorenthel Pharma GmbH: 32 aminopyrazine analogues run in Caco-2, plasma protein binding and kinetic solubility. Solubility was good across most of the set, but several soluble analogues showed high efflux, which led Quorenthel to redesign the exposed amine rather than raise lipophilicity.
